MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Cinema and Songs From The Silver Screen feel like natural next choices because film music connects with my enjoyment of Downton Abbey soundtracks and expressive vocal performances.",
    "Partners appeals to my interest in vocal duets and theatrical singing, which also draws me to A Musical Affair and Stages."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums match something I have enjoyed before, but seasonal repertoire is not what I want to hear right now, even in a live performance.",
    "PTX, Vol. III and 25 do not fit my current interest in orchestral, theatrical, and classical crossover music as closely as the film-song selections do.",
    "The Very Best Of gives me too little information about the artist or repertoire to judge whether I would enjoy it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing preference, although it is only an occasional interest.",
    "Enjoying vocal music does not mean I want every style of singing; contemporary vocal arrangements are less appealing to me right now than theatrical performances."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between soundtracks, musical theatre, and expressive melodic singing matters more to my current choices than simply finding another vocal album.",
    "My most recent listening to relaxing classical music suggests that orchestral sound and a gentler mood also deserve attention."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in expressive vocals and film music, but gave too much weight to occasional Christmas listening and too little to my current orchestral and theatrical interests."
}
